login.setup_sub: This is the first time it has been opened. Choose the administrator password to protect the dashboard.
login.setup_corta: The password must be at least 6 characters.

chart.cartera_vs_recupero: Portfolio vs. expected recovery by arrears bucket

originacion.subtitulo: Every application arrives already assessed: score, suggested decision and explanation. Click a row to see why. The final decision is always the credit officer's.

modelo.prefijo: Model (synthetic demo · retrained on your data):

drawer.decision_final: The final decision is the credit officer's — the model suggests and explains.

originacion.fuente_real: Analyzing the real dataset uploaded in Settings (the same one used on every tab).
originacion.fuente_demo: Demo data. Upload your dataset in Settings and turn the demo off to analyze your real data here and across the whole dashboard.

cartera.subtitulo: Sorted by the AI agent's priority (expected recovery value). Click a row to see the debtor's full briefing.

agenda.subtitulo: Payment promises and payment arrangements past due with no payment logged — the cases that already missed a committed date and are worth picking up first. Real contact still goes through the compliance check.
agenda.vacio_sin_pendientes: There are no overdue promises pending.

plan.sub: {{total}} prioritized contacts; in {{historial}} of them the channel was chosen by the debtor's real contactability (automatic) — for the rest the business rule decides and the operator can pick it by hand.
plan.bloqueado: There is nobody to contact right now: {{motivo}} The plan has {{casos}} cases ready for when contact is allowed.

gestores.subtitulo: Ranking by interaction quality and conversion (data from the interaction log — in the demo it is synthetic; with your real operation it becomes evidence).
gestores.nota_totales: The rates and the quality in the total row are weighted by interaction volume; they are not the simple average of the column.

asistente.subtitulo: Ask the program in English — it answers with the product's own documentation (it does not invent features). With ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, it writes the answer; without a key, it shows you the exact section that answers it.
asistente.placeholder_input: Your question about MV Kobra AI…

chat.ejemplo: Examples: “what do I need to actually place phone calls?” · “how do I connect my ERP?” · “what is ProbPago?”

activar_canales.cuenta_propia: The telephony account is yours. MV Kobra AI does not resell minutes: you open your own account at Twilio and Twilio bills you directly. Nobody else sees your calls or your recordings.
activar_canales.p1: Create the account at twilio.com/try-twilio and leave trial mode (Upgrade). The trial plays a recorded message before every call: with a real debtor, that ruins the interaction.
activar_canales.p2: Buy a number with voice capability (Phone Numbers → Buy a number, Voice checkbox).
activar_canales.p3: Point the number at your program: Voice Configuration → «A call comes in» → Webhook, with the public URL of your voice service ending in /voz/entrante, POST method. It is the step almost every guide skips, and the number one reason for «outbound calls work but inbound ones do not».
activar_canales.p4: Enter the Account SID and Auth Token in Settings. They stay on your machine.
activar_canales.p5: Test with your own cell phone before you test with anyone else.
activar_canales.aviso_token: Never send the Auth Token by email or WhatsApp — not to us, not to anyone. With that token someone can place calls, buy numbers and listen to your recordings, and whatever they spend, you pay.
activar_canales.nota_pais: The requirements for a local number change by country: in Uruguay and several countries in the region they ask for company documentation, and it takes time. Find that out before you promise a go-live date. And you need the consent of the person you are calling.
activar_canales.wa_texto: For a company to start a conversation —which is exactly what a collections interaction does— Meta requires an approved message template. You need a WhatsApp Business account linked to Twilio, at least one approved template (approval takes time) and its identifier entered in Settings. Without a template, the program sends nothing and tells you why: it is not a system error, it is Meta's requirement. Replying to a message the debtor started does not need a template.

configuracion.subtitulo: Keys are stored encrypted on the server (the system keyring or an encrypted file, same as in the classic dashboard) and load on their own at every startup. Leave blank whatever you do not want to change.

escenarios.subtitulo: Two complete synthetic companies, with data for every module. Pick the one that looks most like whoever you are showing the product to. The demo toggle above decides whether the demo or your real portfolio is shown.
escenarios.todo_ok: All modules verified with the active data.
escenarios.hay_fallas: Some modules failed — the detail says what broke.

paso1.texto: Your collections prioritized by AI: the ProbPago model computes each debtor's probability of payment and the Negotiator Agent picks the strategy and the channel. This tour gets you oriented in 4 steps.

paso2.texto: The list already comes sorted by expected recovery value. Filter by segment/aging bucket/propensity and click any row to see the debtor's full briefing, with a suggested script.

paso3.texto: Agenda holds the overdue payment promises that are worth picking back up today. In Agents, your team's ranking by quality and conversion — with real data once you start logging interactions.

paso4.texto: Any question about the program, ask it in the Assistant: it answers with the product's real documentation, in English. And in Settings you enter your keys just once.

roi.subtitulo: Estimate how much additional recovery MV Kobra AI generates on your portfolio. The improvement is an editable assumption — the real number is validated in a pilot with your portfolio, not here.

in.recupero_actual: Current annual recovery (% of the portfolio)
in.costo: Annual cost of MV Kobra AI ({{moneda}})
in.costo_placeholder: e.g.: Pro plan × 12 months, in your currency

roi.supuesto: The improvement is an assumption for simulating, not a promise: the honest number comes out of a pilot measuring with vs. without the tool on your real portfolio.

informe_email.subtitulo: Every Monday morning, the Executive Report in PDF arrives on its own in the inbox you choose (it uses your corporate SMTP, already configured in the keys). Requires the real-time service running 24/7, just like the automatic campaign.
informe_email.smtp_falta: The corporate SMTP still has to be configured (SMTP_* keys) for delivery to work.

alta_tenant.subtitulo: Creates a new company with a sample of synthetic data, ready to sign in to (same password + the company name at the login). Ideal for giving a prospect an isolated trial.

analizar_voz.subtitulo: Upload a real .wav or .mp3: diarization (who is speaking), acoustic emotion from prosody (tone, energy, pace) — it detects the customer's tension in the voice, beyond the words.
analizar_voz.copiloto_ok: Transcript available (Whisper) — the Copilot rated the quality of the call and detected negotiation techniques.
analizar_voz.sin_transcripcion: Diarization + acoustic emotion only (no text): set OPENAI_API_KEY to transcribe with Whisper and add the Copilot's evaluation.

importar_cartera.subtitulo: Upload a CSV or Excel file with your debtors and it instantly replaces the demo data across the whole dashboard. It adapts on its own to your column names: if there are several money columns it picks the debt one (Deuda, Adeudo, Saldo Vencido, Capital) over a payment or a collection; it understands MontoDeuda, Nombre Cliente, Celular… and formatted amounts ($ 1.234.567).
importar_cartera.sin_real_aun: — upload a file below to activate
importar_cartera.sql_ayuda: Connect your database (Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle…) and pull in your entire portfolio with no size limit. Read only: any query that is not a SELECT is rejected. The query must return at least one debt column (deuda/monto/monto_deuda), and optionally nombre, telefono, dias_mora, etc.
importar_cartera.sql_consulta_placeholder: SELECT nombre, telefono, monto_deuda, dias_mora FROM cartera
importar_cartera.origen_demo: You are still seeing demonstration (synthetic) data.
importar_cartera.banner_demo: You are seeing DEMONSTRATION (synthetic) data. To see your real portfolio: Settings → Load your real portfolio → «MY PORTFOLIO» button.

proveedor_ia.subtitulo: Which of your own corporate accounts the Assistant, the Copilot and the AI Agent reason with. Enter the matching key above, in the key table.
proveedor_ia.modelo_ayuda: Model inside your account — picking a small one keeps your token usage down; Refresh pulls the provider's latest published versions.
proveedor_ia.nunca_actualizado: Catalog never updated — the reference model is shown; tap Refresh (with the key entered) to pull the current ones.

activacion.subtitulo: Paste the license you received when you bought (or from the 7-day trial) to activate your copy of MV Kobra AI.
activacion.subtitulo_vencida: Your license expired. Buy a plan or request a new trial to keep using MV Kobra AI.

gestor_demo.subtitulo: Show a customer how the agent negotiates a collection on its own. It uses a sample debtor (Martín Viera: 3 instalments in arrears, $U 120.000 salary). Pick the channel and watch the full negotiation with its conclusions.
gestor_demo.nota_twilio: This is the same negotiation logic that runs in production. Twilio only carries the real voice or WhatsApp (it needs credentials and a number); the offer, the objection handling and the close are these.
gestor_demo.nota_voz: Browser voice, so you can hear the demo without configuring anything. On a real call it is the product's neural voice that speaks.
gestor_demo.sin_voces: This machine has no voices installed, so the conversation can only be read.

calidad.subtitulo: Scoring of the quality of collections interactions (a 14-criterion rubric calibrated against real supervisors) and performance comparison between the AI Agent and human agents.
calidad.titulo_grafico: Quality and conversion: AI vs Human
calidad.evaluar_sub: Paste the transcript of a call or the WhatsApp chat and get the quality score with the breakdown by criterion. The core works without keys; with an AI provider configured, it recalibrates like a real supervisor.
calidad.evaluar_placeholder:
Agent: Hello, good morning, I'm calling from collections…
Customer: Yes, that's me…
calidad.perfil_titulo: Profile by negotiation item: AI vs Human
calidad.perfil_sub: Estimated score by rubric criterion. Shows which negotiation items the AI Agent has the edge on and where human agents have the most room to improve.
calidad.evolucion_sub: Monthly average quality by agent type.
calidad.mejora_titulo: How collections would improve by improving quality
calidad.mejora_sub: If human agents reached the quality and effectiveness of the AI Agent, the estimated additional recovery would be:
calidad.mejora_nota: Illustrative estimate based on the real gap observed between the two groups (synthetic demo data).
calidad.audio_sub: Upload a real recording: it is transcribed by speaker and scored against the 14-criterion rubric. You can listen to the call while you review the score.
calidad.audio_sin_texto: The audio was processed but there is no text transcript (set OPENAI_API_KEY for Whisper, or paste the transcript into “Score text”).
calidad.avaya_sin_config: To connect the Avaya PBX (or any recorder via API), configure the customer's credentials (KOBRA_AVAYA_HOST, KOBRA_AVAYA_USER, KOBRA_AVAYA_PASS). In the meantime, upload the recordings manually.
calidad.avaya_conectado: Connector active: PBX recordings are imported and scored automatically.
calidad.audio_guardar_hint: Enter the agent's name and the date to accumulate this scoring in their scorecard.
calidad.fichas_sub: Accumulated call scorings. Identify each agent's quality by date and how it evolves over time.
calidad.fichas_vacio: There are no scored and saved recordings yet. Upload calls under «Audio / calls» specifying the agent.

panel.vacio: There are no scored calls yet. Upload recordings under «Score audio» and the panel builds itself.
panel.por_aspecto_sub: Each bar is the % of the criterion's maximum. The vertical line marks the team average.

portal.footer: Payments processed by your creditor's collections platform.
portal.entrar_con_codigo: Sign in with username and code

login.subtitulo: Enter the username and the 6-digit code the company sent you.

pagar.transferencia_det: Get the account details and a payment reference
pagar.mercadopago_det: Pay online with your preferred method

pagoref.instruccion_transferencia: Include the reference in the transfer description so the payment is posted automatically.
pagoref.instruccion_mp: A MercadoPago window opened for you to complete the payment.

exito.detalle: We recorded your payment of {{monto}} with reference {{referencia}}.
exito.aprobado: The payment was approved and posted in the company's system.
exito.informado: Your payment was recorded; the company will reconcile it before crediting it.
exito.deuda_saldada: Your debt is now fully settled. Thank you.

portal_admin.subtitulo: Collect centrally: each debtor gets a link, a QR code or a username with a code, pays in full or partially (bank transfer or MercadoPago) and the payment is posted to your ERP/CRM automatically.

config.subtitulo: What you configure here is what the debtor sees when they sign in to pay.
config.mp_link: Payment link from your MercadoPago account (optional)
config.mp_ayuda: If you don't enter a link, the demo uses a simulated checkout. With your real link, the payment goes straight into your account.
config.api_key: Your own API key (optional; if left blank, one is generated)
config.erp_ayuda: Every payment is sent via webhook and can also be queried through the API (incremental pull). Example:

acceso.subtitulo: Generate the payment link, the QR code and the credentials to share over WhatsApp, email or printed on the invoice.
acceso.ayuda_qr: The QR code points to the same link: print it on the invoice or share it over WhatsApp.

pagos.vacio: No payments have come in through the portal yet.

plan.aviso: You have used {{usado}} of the {{cupo}} cases in your plan this month.
plan.agotado: You have reached the {{cupo}} cases in your plan this month. Your portfolio, your reports and your exports are still available; to work cases again, upgrade your plan.
plan.excedente: You are {{excedente}} cases over the {{cupo}} in your plan — they are billed as overage.

cxc.subtitulo: The receivables analysis computed on your real portfolio: aging report, DSO, collection effectiveness, payment reconciliation and misapplied payments. These are calculations, not generated answers — the same data always yields the same number, which is why they hold up for closing a month.

antiguedad.sub: How much is owed in each aging bucket. It is the basis for everything else.

concentracion.resumen: The {{n}} largest debtors account for {{pct}} of the portfolio.

dso.sub: How many days it takes to collect a sale. You enter the credit sales (Kobra sees collections, not invoicing); the balance comes from your portfolio.

efectividad.sub: Amount collected over amount worked. It comes from the interactions you already log.
efectividad.sin_datos: There are no interactions logged yet to compute it.

conciliar.titulo: Which invoice does this payment belong to?
conciliar.sub: It finds the invoice, or the combination of invoices, that adds up to exactly the amount received. If more than one is possible, it says so and does not pick.
conciliar.ambiguo: There is more than one possible combination — none is applied automatically:
conciliar.sin_match: No amount matches. The closest ones:

anomalias.sub: Possible duplicates, payments with no invoice and amounts that do not match. It flags, it does not fix.

demo.subtitulo: The whole circuit with a real case, to show a customer that this is not a video: the agent really calls, really writes and the payment really comes in. All of it is operated from here.
demo.falta_titulo: The contact is missing for the phone to ring
demo.falta_sub: Without the phone the circuit runs just the same —link, payment, balance, promise— but nobody gets called.
demo.donde_se_guarda: It is stored encrypted on this machine, never in the repository.
demo.contactar_sub: Dials the phone number on the case and sends the WhatsApp with the portal link.
demo.falta_base_url: PUBLIC_BASE_URL is missing: without a public URL, Twilio can't find the voice webhook.
demo.escanear: Scan the QR code with your phone to pay, or open the checkout here.
demo.qr_alt: QR code for the payment link
demo.modo_prueba: Test mode — pay it with a fictitious card:
demo.titular: Cardholder {{apro}} approves the payment and {{othe}} declines it.
demo.payment_id_ayuda: Without the payment_id the payment is left as informed instead of approved.
demo.cobro_informado: Left as informed: posted, pending reconciliation.
demo.diferencia_titulo: A balance of {{saldo}} remains — the difference gets negotiated
demo.promesa_ok: Payment promise logged. It is already in follow-up: if the date passes without the payment, it shows up in the agenda.
demo.cancelada: Debt paid off. The circuit ran end to end.

almacenamiento.titulo: Data folder (which disk it saves to)
almacenamiento.subtitulo: This is where the portfolio, the exports, the models, the backups and the audit log are written. Installing the program on another disk is not enough: if the data keeps going to a full C:, it breaks all the same when you import the first portfolio.
almacenamiento.carpeta_aria: Folder to save the data in
almacenamiento.forzada_env: The folder is pinned by the KOBRA_DATA_DIR environment variable, so whatever you choose here does not apply until you remove it.

gobernanza.subtitulo: Which data is personal, who sees it, whether it's usable and where it came from.
gobernanza.dimensiones_sub: The DAMA standard: the vocabulary a data team already uses.
gobernanza.catalogo_sub: Depending on your role, some are shown masked.
gobernanza.integridad_sub: Each entry chains the hash of the previous one: editing or deleting a line is detected.
gobernanza.integridad_rota: Chain broken — the log was altered
gobernanza.no_aplican: {{n}} rules do not apply to these columns.
gobernanza.no_incluido_titulo: Data governance is not in your plan
gobernanza.no_incluido_sub: It's the module a company asks for before letting its real data in.
gobernanza.venta_clasificacion: Classifies every column: what is personal data and what is sensitive data.
gobernanza.venta_enmascarado: Masks by role, in exports too.
gobernanza.venta_calidad: Quality rules across the six DAMA dimensions.
gobernanza.venta_linaje: Lineage: where each number came from and what breaks if it changes.

medidas.subtitulo: Define your own indicators with a formula, without asking for development work.
medidas.editor_sub: Test every formula before saving: the error has to show up for you, not for whoever opens the board.
medidas.solo_admin_edita: Only an administrator can change the definitions: these are the indicators the whole team sees.
medidas.no_incluido_titulo: Custom KPIs are not in your plan
medidas.no_incluido_sub: Define your own indicators with formulas, without depending on custom development.

automl.subtitulo: Upload a table of your own, choose what you want to predict, and Kobra tests several models.
automl.nota_archivo: CSV or Excel, up to 50 MB. The file is not stored: it is read, used to train, and discarded.
automl.nota_fecha: If your data has a time order, indicate the date: the splits are made by time and not at random. Training on the future to predict the past inflates the result and cannot be reproduced in production.
automl.kpi_auc_sub: data that was not used for anything
automl.kpi_brecha_sub: how much it would have been overstated
automl.avisos_titulo: Things to check before trusting the model
automl.importancias_sub: In collections you have to be able to justify why someone is prioritized.
automl.candidatos_sub: Sorted by their result on the selection split.
automl.nota_seleccion: These numbers come from the split where the model was selected, so they are optimistic by construction. The honest number is the AUC on holdout, above.
automl.solo_admin: Only an administrator can train models with the company's data.
automl.no_incluido_titulo: Training with your data is not in your plan
automl.no_incluido_sub: Upload your own table and Kobra trains a custom model, with a metric that does not overstate.
automl.bd_nota: The credentials travel only in this request: they are not stored in the browser or on the server, and they never appear in the audit log.

tablero.titulo: What do you want to analyze today?
tablero.subtitulo: Ask about your portfolio in English. The numbers come from your data, not from an estimate.
tablero.preguntar_ph: Type your question about the business…
tablero.sin_ia: To ask in English you have to configure an AI provider in Settings. The indicators, warnings and actions below work just the same.
tablero.ver_datos: See the exact data used to answer
tablero.nota_calculo: Every indicator is computed on your portfolio. The AI only writes the answer: it does not estimate or project numbers.

logistica.subtitulo: What to discount, what to restock, what to reprice and who to win back.
logistica.sin_datos: You haven't uploaded your data yet.
logistica.sin_datos_sub: Upload your product and sales tables to get started.
logistica.nada_que_sugerir: Nothing to suggest here — everything is in order.
logistica.no_incluido_titulo: Logistics is not in your plan
logistica.no_incluido_sub: It's a separate module: bought on its own, without changing your current plan.
logistica.venta_1: What to discount, with a discount that doesn't break your margin.
logistica.venta_2: What to buy before you run out of stock.
logistica.venta_3: Which products are running a margin below their category.
logistica.venta_4: Which customers stopped buying and how much winning them back is worth.

proyectos.subtitulo: Portfolio health and what to do first.
proyectos.salud_sub: Six dimensions. The breakdown says what to fix, not just that something is off.
proyectos.backlog_sub: By expected value: impact, urgency and how many tasks stall if it slips.
proyectos.sin_datos: You haven't uploaded your projects yet.
proyectos.sin_datos_sub: Upload your project and task tables to get started.
proyectos.no_incluido_titulo: Projects is not in your plan
proyectos.no_incluido_sub: It's a separate module: bought on its own, without changing your current plan.
proyectos.venta_1: Health index across six dimensions, with a rules engine — not an opinion.
proyectos.venta_2: Backlog ranked by expected value, not by who pushes hardest.
proyectos.venta_3: Budget alert before hitting 100%, while there's still time to react.
proyectos.venta_4: Detects orphan dependencies: the symptom of a plan that went stale.

ingdatos.subtitulo: What's in your data, how your tables join and what's broken — before you start.
ingdatos.subir: Upload a CSV or Excel file
ingdatos.url_ayuda: It stays on your server: it is never saved or written to the log.
ingdatos.tabla_ph: empty = the first tables in the database are read
ingdatos.consulta_ayuda: SELECT only. It is validated against the real catalog before it runs.
ingdatos.tipado_aviso: Columns that were stored as text and actually weren't:
ingdatos.sin_pk: No column was found that identifies each row.
ingdatos.sin_fk: No columns pointing to another table were detected.
ingdatos.features_intro: Every feature with the formula that generates it: one you can't explain is one you can't defend before a risk committee.
ingdatos.joins_intro: Detected by real value overlap, not just by the column name.

memoria.subtitulo: What the program does, in order, told twice: once for whoever reads the code and once for whoever signs the purchase.
memoria.aviso_demo: This installation runs on synthetic data: the impact figures are illustrative, not results measured in production.

frecuencia.subtitulo: When each table the program uses was last updated, and whether that arrived late.
